blockingFindings: Circular query/qrel-derived vector construction created label leakage.
Templated pseudo-replicates did not provide credible held-out coverage.
Graph, freshness, contradiction, negative, and filter claims were not substantively demonstrated.
Cross-partition wording and intents remained insufficiently distinct.
Semantic fields, graph paths, filter decoys, and expected evidence fields were not all enforced by scoring.
The corpus author could still self-author acceptance.
A targeted retrieval test was red.
Regression coverage was missing for authorization, graph-locator binding, evaluation modes, and evidence expectations.
Multi-hop result-type and locator endpoint requirements were incomplete.

limitations: The independent reviewer is a separate agent, not a human adjudicator.
Only three real source families were available; missing domain coverage uses explicitly labeled synthetic fixtures.
